annotations.title: Report a shared email-reading rule (hack) that is broken or harmful

description: Reports a community hack someone else shares: broken (it reads messages wrong or writes wrong values), private_data (its template or examples hold a real person's details), or harmful. Say what you saw in details, without the person's own data. A private_data report, or three reports of any kind, takes it out of search at once until its author shares a fixed version, and the TrackerHacker team looks at it. Copies people already have stay theirs.
